title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1987-09-19
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Outstanding 2nd‑set performance captured on a solid soundboard source, but the recording is incomplete (Space cuts early and Miracle missing)
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the musical quality of this show – especially the “primo” second set – and note that the SBD source sounds excellent. However, the recording is flawed: the Space track ends a minute early and the entire Miracle segment is absent, which led to a very low star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: The performance itself is praised as outstanding (high show score), but the missing portions of the recording are a serious drawback, resulting in an overall rating below average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear SBD sound, but Space cuts off ~1 min early and Miracle is completely missing; likely upload/encoding issue rather than source quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as “primo”; no specific song critiques, but overall musical performance described as outstanding.
